meta.title: Swift Trailblaze
meta.description: Clear a path through the thorns, keeping your eyes on the faint light beyond.

units.rawText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth, near Energy Tower No. 4.
units.displayText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth, near Energy Tower No. 4.

spans.text: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth, near Energy Tower No. 4.

units.rawText: The Entropics roam through the Labyrinth as though looking for something.
units.displayText: The Entropics roam through the Labyrinth as though looking for something.

spans.text: The Entropics roam through the Labyrinth as though looking for something.

units.rawText: Whoosh—
units.displayText: Whoosh—

spans.text: Whoosh—

units.rawText: A ray of golden light draws the Entropics' attention.
units.displayText: A ray of golden light draws the Entropics' attention.

spans.text: A ray of golden light draws the Entropics' attention.

units.rawText: Where are you looking at, Daemons?
units.displayText: Where are you looking at, Daemons?

spans.text: Where are you looking at, Daemons?

units.rawText: The Entropics in the labyrinth turns to look at the petite girl floating in the air. A massive quantity of operands is gathered in her hands.
units.displayText: The Entropics in the labyrinth turns to look at the petite girl floating in the air. A massive quantity of operands is gathered in her hands.

spans.text: The Entropics in the labyrinth turns to look at the petite girl floating in the air. A massive quantity of operands is gathered in her hands.

units.rawText: O arrow that punishes Daemons and defends order... Open up a path to victory for us, Judgement Arrow!
units.displayText: O arrow that punishes Daemons and defends order... Open up a path to victory for us, Judgement Arrow!

spans.text: O arrow that punishes Daemons and defends order... Open up a path to victory for us, Judgement Arrow!

units.rawText: The girl loosens her bowstring, and the shining arrow flies toward the energy tower.
units.displayText: The girl loosens her bowstring, and the shining arrow flies toward the energy tower.

spans.text: The girl loosens her bowstring, and the shining arrow flies toward the energy tower.

units.rawText: The golden arrow instantly slays every single Entropic in its path and then savagely crashes into the energy tower.
units.displayText: The golden arrow instantly slays every single Entropic in its path and then savagely crashes into the energy tower.

spans.text: The golden arrow instantly slays every single Entropic in its path and then savagely crashes into the energy tower.

units.rawText: Kaboom—
units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: Direct hit.
units.displayText: Direct hit.

spans.text: Direct hit.

units.rawText: Alcyone stands firm amidst the shockwave, still aiming in the direction of the tower with her bow.
units.displayText: Alcyone stands firm amidst the shockwave, still aiming in the direction of the tower with her bow.

spans.text: Alcyone stands firm amidst the shockwave, still aiming in the direction of the tower with her bow.

units.rawText: Attack complete, operands expended: 1%...
units.displayText: Attack complete, operands expended: 1%...

spans.text: Attack complete, operands expended: 1%...

units.rawText: You worked hard, Ally~
units.displayText: You worked hard, Ally~

spans.text: You worked hard, Ally~

units.rawText: According to their previous transmission, <cmdr> and Atlas have reached their objective, so we need to buy them some more time.
units.displayText: According to their previous transmission, {교수} and Atlas have reached their objective, so we need to buy them some more time.

spans.text: According to their previous transmission,
and Atlas have reached their objective, so we need to buy them some more time.

units.rawText: Since we need to cover for Lord Eosphorus as well, just blowing up the energy tower here won't draw enough Entropics over, so we need to find another way...
units.displayText: Since we need to cover for Lord Eosphorus as well, just blowing up the energy tower here won't draw enough Entropics over, so we need to find another way...

spans.text: Since we need to cover for Lord Eosphorus as well, just blowing up the energy tower here won't draw enough Entropics over, so we need to find another way...

units.rawText: Staaaaaare—
units.displayText: Staaaaaare—

spans.text: Staaaaaare—

units.rawText: ...What were you doing, Electra?
units.displayText: ...What were you doing, Electra?

spans.text: ...What were you doing, Electra?

units.rawText: Ueh? Was I entranced by your focused sincerity, Ally?
units.displayText: Ueh? Was I entranced by your focused sincerity, Ally?

spans.text: Ueh? Was I entranced by your focused sincerity, Ally?

units.rawText: ...I'm talking about when I blew up that energy tower just now!
units.displayText: ...I'm talking about when I blew up that energy tower just now!

spans.text: ...I'm talking about when I blew up that energy tower just now!

units.rawText: Uh, keeping watch?
units.displayText: Uh, keeping watch?

spans.text: Uh, keeping watch?

units.rawText: Then why didn't I see you when I was attacking just now? Or rather, where did you go each time I launched an attack?!
units.displayText: Then why didn't I see you when I was attacking just now? Or rather, where did you go each time I launched an attack?!

spans.text: Then why didn't I see you when I was attacking just now? Or rather, where did you go each time I launched an attack?!

units.rawText: You... Were you hiding somewhere to sleep, just like during our previous combat exercises?
units.displayText: You... Were you hiding somewhere to sleep, just like during our previous combat exercises?

spans.text: You... Were you hiding somewhere to sleep, just like during our previous combat exercises?

units.rawText: How rude! This is an important mission, so of course I've been working hard! It's just that you're too capable, Ally.
units.displayText: How rude! This is an important mission, so of course I've been working hard! It's just that you're too capable, Ally.

spans.text: How rude! This is an important mission, so of course I've been working hard! It's just that you're too capable, Ally.

units.rawText: Humph! I just did the bare minimum that any self-respecting Sanctifier would. As one of the Greater Sanctifiers who lead the charge into the Tartarus Sector, it's only natural that I do a good job!
units.displayText: Humph! I just did the bare minimum that any self-respecting Sanctifier would. As one of the Greater Sanctifiers who lead the charge into the Tartarus Sector, it's only natural that I do a good job!

spans.text: Humph! I just did the bare minimum that any self-respecting Sanctifier would. As one of the Greater Sanctifiers who lead the charge into the Tartarus Sector, it's only natural that I do a good job!

units.rawText: Despite her words, Alcyone still puffs up her chest. Meanwhile, Electra smiles and pinches Alcyone's cheeks before rubbing and squishing them.
units.displayText: Despite her words, Alcyone still puffs up her chest. Meanwhile, Electra smiles and pinches Alcyone's cheeks before rubbing and squishing them.

spans.text: Despite her words, Alcyone still puffs up her chest. Meanwhile, Electra smiles and pinches Alcyone's cheeks before rubbing and squishing them.

units.rawText: Quit squishing my cheeks and tell me how many operands you've used so far.
units.displayText: Quit squishing my cheeks and tell me how many operands you've used so far.

spans.text: Quit squishing my cheeks and tell me how many operands you've used so far.

units.rawText: Thanks to Ally's hard work, I've only expended 7% of my operands~
units.displayText: Thanks to Ally's hard work, I've only expended 7% of my operands~

spans.text: Thanks to Ally's hard work, I've only expended 7% of my operands~

units.rawText: Electra affectionately pats Alcyone's head, but the latter pushes her away in annoyance.
units.displayText: Electra affectionately pats Alcyone's head, but the latter pushes her away in annoyance.

spans.text: Electra affectionately pats Alcyone's head, but the latter pushes her away in annoyance.

units.rawText: In that case, we ought to move on to the next area right away...
units.displayText: In that case, we ought to move on to the next area right away...

spans.text: In that case, we ought to move on to the next area right away...

units.rawText: Huh? We're not going to take a break? I think this is a good time to sla... I mean, to rest! It's very important!
units.displayText: Huh? We're not going to take a break? I think this is a good time to sla... I mean, to rest! It's very important!

spans.text: Huh? We're not going to take a break? I think this is a good time to sla... I mean, to rest! It's very important!

units.rawText: As Alcyone carefully plans their next move, Electra takes the opportunity to sweep her twin blades clean of the purple liquid staining them.
units.displayText: As Alcyone carefully plans their next move, Electra takes the opportunity to sweep her twin blades clean of the purple liquid staining them.

spans.text: As Alcyone carefully plans their next move, Electra takes the opportunity to sweep her twin blades clean of the purple liquid staining them.

units.rawText:
This mission prioritizes stealth, so Lord Eosphorus only brought five Greater Sanctifiers with him lest a large-scale troop movement tip off the Entropics.
Our mission is difficult, so we have to be careful and serious about it.
units.displayText:
This mission prioritizes stealth, so Lord Eosphorus only brought five Greater Sanctifiers with him lest a large-scale troop movement tip off the Entropics.
Our mission is difficult, so we have to be careful and serious about it.

spans.text:
This mission prioritizes stealth, so Lord Eosphorus only brought five Greater Sanctifiers with him lest a large-scale troop movement tip off the Entropics.
Our mission is difficult, so we have to be careful and serious about it.

units.rawText: Since we need to reduce the pressure on Lord Eosphorus and <cmdr>'s teams at the same time... we should go deeper into the Labyrinth.
units.displayText: Since we need to reduce the pressure on Lord Eosphorus and {교수}'s teams at the same time... we should go deeper into the Labyrinth.

spans.text: Since we need to reduce the pressure on Lord Eosphorus and
's teams at the same time... we should go deeper into the Labyrinth.

units.rawText: You were preparing to slack off just now, weren't you, Electra? You'd best hurry and prepare yourself.
units.displayText: You were preparing to slack off just now, weren't you, Electra? You'd best hurry and prepare yourself.

spans.text: You were preparing to slack off just now, weren't you, Electra? You'd best hurry and prepare yourself.

units.rawText: Yesyesyes... But since we only just destroyed that energy tower, we should wait for the labyrinth to finish its current round of shifting before making a move.
units.displayText: Yesyesyes... But since we only just destroyed that energy tower, we should wait for the labyrinth to finish its current round of shifting before making a move.

spans.text: Yesyesyes... But since we only just destroyed that energy tower, we should wait for the labyrinth to finish its current round of shifting before making a move.

units.rawText: Can't you even put in some effort for just a few...
units.displayText: Can't you even put in some effort for just a few...

spans.text: Can't you even put in some effort for just a few...

units.rawText: Rumblerumblerumble—
units.displayText: Rumblerumblerumble—

spans.text: Rumblerumblerumble—

units.rawText: After the thunderous crash of hard objects colliding with each other, the environment around the two of them shifts quickly.
units.displayText: After the thunderous crash of hard objects colliding with each other, the environment around the two of them shifts quickly.

spans.text: After the thunderous crash of hard objects colliding with each other, the environment around the two of them shifts quickly.

units.rawText: ...Huh? Is it me or is the labyrinth shifting more quickly now?
units.displayText: ...Huh? Is it me or is the labyrinth shifting more quickly now?

spans.text: ...Huh? Is it me or is the labyrinth shifting more quickly now?

units.rawText: Maybe it's because of what <cmdr> and Atlas are doing. Looks like we'd best pick up the pace.
units.displayText: Maybe it's because of what {교수} and Atlas are doing. Looks like we'd best pick up the pace.

spans.text: Maybe it's because of what
and Atlas are doing. Looks like we'd best pick up the pace.

units.rawText: We're going to have to map the place out again... Ah, what a pain; Ally, carry meeee mfffff...
units.displayText: We're going to have to map the place out again... Ah, what a pain; Ally, carry meeee mfffff...

spans.text: We're going to have to map the place out again... Ah, what a pain; Ally, carry meeee mfffff...

units.rawText: Before Electra could finish speaking, Alcyone clasped her tiny hand over her mouth.
units.displayText: Before Electra could finish speaking, Alcyone clasped her tiny hand over her mouth.

spans.text: Before Electra could finish speaking, Alcyone clasped her tiny hand over her mouth.

units.rawText: Shhh—
units.displayText: Shhh—

spans.text: Shhh—

units.rawText: The Shifting Labyrinth reveals a brand new path. A squad of Entropics emerges from behind a bunch of walls with indistinct boundaries and moves as a group toward a certain direction.
units.displayText: The Shifting Labyrinth reveals a brand new path. A squad of Entropics emerges from behind a bunch of walls with indistinct boundaries and moves as a group toward a certain direction.

spans.text: The Shifting Labyrinth reveals a brand new path. A squad of Entropics emerges from behind a bunch of walls with indistinct boundaries and moves as a group toward a certain direction.

units.rawText: These Entropics look hurt...
units.displayText: These Entropics look hurt...

spans.text: These Entropics look hurt...

units.rawText: And I was just thinking about how to go deeper in. Looks like our path has revealed itself. Let's go; don't disturb them.
units.displayText: And I was just thinking about how to go deeper in. Looks like our path has revealed itself. Let's go; don't disturb them.

spans.text: And I was just thinking about how to go deeper in. Looks like our path has revealed itself. Let's go; don't disturb them.

units.rawText: Alcyone and Electra follow the Entropics while keeping a distance from them.
units.displayText: Alcyone and Electra follow the Entropics while keeping a distance from them.

spans.text: Alcyone and Electra follow the Entropics while keeping a distance from them.

units.rawText: Feels nice to have someone leading the way. I wonder where they're headed~
units.displayText: Feels nice to have someone leading the way. I wonder where they're headed~

spans.text: Feels nice to have someone leading the way. I wonder where they're headed~

units.rawText: Even if they don't take us to a place where we want to go, we can still record their activity patterns, which might come in handy for figuring out the labyrinth's patterns.
units.displayText: Even if they don't take us to a place where we want to go, we can still record their activity patterns, which might come in handy for figuring out the labyrinth's patterns.

spans.text: Even if they don't take us to a place where we want to go, we can still record their activity patterns, which might come in handy for figuring out the labyrinth's patterns.

units.rawText: Hm? Look over there, Ally. Another group of Entropics linked up with them. It looks like they came from the Middle Ring.
units.displayText: Hm? Look over there, Ally. Another group of Entropics linked up with them. It looks like they came from the Middle Ring.

spans.text: Hm? Look over there, Ally. Another group of Entropics linked up with them. It looks like they came from the Middle Ring.

units.rawText: The two Entropic forces join up, and after quickly exchanging their operands, they move further into the Outer Ring.
units.displayText: The two Entropic forces join up, and after quickly exchanging their operands, they move further into the Outer Ring.

spans.text: The two Entropic forces join up, and after quickly exchanging their operands, they move further into the Outer Ring.

units.rawText: All those Entropics are headed that way... Hehe, we might have caught a big fish.
units.displayText: All those Entropics are headed that way... Hehe, we might have caught a big fish.

spans.text: All those Entropics are headed that way... Hehe, we might have caught a big fish.

units.rawText: Those look like Low-Order Entropics from the frontlines and Entropics from the Middle Ring... Could it be...
units.displayText: Those look like Low-Order Entropics from the frontlines and Entropics from the Middle Ring... Could it be...

spans.text: Those look like Low-Order Entropics from the frontlines and Entropics from the Middle Ring... Could it be...

units.rawText: Electra, we're here.
units.displayText: Electra, we're here.

spans.text: Electra, we're here.

units.rawText: Electra looks up and follows Alcyone's gaze. Beyond the rows of walls stands a tower-like structure, glowing from within.
units.displayText: Electra looks up and follows Alcyone's gaze. Beyond the rows of walls stands a tower-like structure, glowing from within.

spans.text: Electra looks up and follows Alcyone's gaze. Beyond the rows of walls stands a tower-like structure, glowing from within.

units.rawText: Is that an energy tower? But its size...
units.displayText: Is that an energy tower? But its size...

spans.text: Is that an energy tower? But its size...

units.rawText: Initial scans conclude that it contains over 5 times the amount of operands compared to the tower we just destroyed.
units.displayText: Initial scans conclude that it contains over 5 times the amount of operands compared to the tower we just destroyed.

spans.text: Initial scans conclude that it contains over 5 times the amount of operands compared to the tower we just destroyed.

units.rawText: Looks like this is the main energy tower providing power to the Outer Ring. Talk about a big fish!
units.displayText: Looks like this is the main energy tower providing power to the Outer Ring. Talk about a big fish!

spans.text: Looks like this is the main energy tower providing power to the Outer Ring. Talk about a big fish!

units.rawText: Although, it seems there are several times more Entropics around it than the other locations... Fortunately, there aren't any high-threat entities among them.
units.displayText: Although, it seems there are several times more Entropics around it than the other locations... Fortunately, there aren't any high-threat entities among them.

spans.text: Although, it seems there are several times more Entropics around it than the other locations... Fortunately, there aren't any high-threat entities among them.

units.rawText: But of course. Their main forces are being tied up by the Sanctifiers on the border battlefront! Electra, get ready to fight!
units.displayText: But of course. Their main forces are being tied up by the Sanctifiers on the border battlefront! Electra, get ready to fight!

spans.text: But of course. Their main forces are being tied up by the Sanctifiers on the border battlefront! Electra, get ready to fight!

units.rawText: Wait a minute, Ally, this wasn't part of the plan. Maybe we should be careful...
units.displayText: Wait a minute, Ally, this wasn't part of the plan. Maybe we should be careful...

spans.text: Wait a minute, Ally, this wasn't part of the plan. Maybe we should be careful...

units.rawText: Relax, I've already shared the information on the main energy tower with the others, and I've verified the state of the Entropics in this area.
units.displayText: Relax, I've already shared the information on the main energy tower with the others, and I've verified the state of the Entropics in this area.

spans.text: Relax, I've already shared the information on the main energy tower with the others, and I've verified the state of the Entropics in this area.

units.rawText: Alcyone finishes typing and then closes her terminal.
units.displayText: Alcyone finishes typing and then closes her terminal.

spans.text: Alcyone finishes typing and then closes her terminal.

units.rawText: Our current operand expenditures are fairly light and these Entropics don't pose a threat to us at all. In the worst-case scenario, even if a High-Order Daemon shows up, they won't be a match for us.
units.displayText: Our current operand expenditures are fairly light and these Entropics don't pose a threat to us at all. In the worst-case scenario, even if a High-Order Daemon shows up, they won't be a match for us.

spans.text: Our current operand expenditures are fairly light and these Entropics don't pose a threat to us at all. In the worst-case scenario, even if a High-Order Daemon shows up, they won't be a match for us.

units.rawText: But all we need to do is destroy the small energy towers and buy time for the others. Surely we don't need to take this risk, right?
units.displayText: But all we need to do is destroy the small energy towers and buy time for the others. Surely we don't need to take this risk, right?

spans.text: But all we need to do is destroy the small energy towers and buy time for the others. Surely we don't need to take this risk, right?

units.rawText: Electra, Lord Eosphorus only gave us the basics of our mission, but I'm sure he wouldn't want us to only do the minimum. This tower is so important that we can't let this opportunity go.
units.displayText: Electra, Lord Eosphorus only gave us the basics of our mission, but I'm sure he wouldn't want us to only do the minimum. This tower is so important that we can't let this opportunity go.

spans.text: Electra, Lord Eosphorus only gave us the basics of our mission, but I'm sure he wouldn't want us to only do the minimum. This tower is so important that we can't let this opportunity go.

units.rawText: Alcyone plants a hand on her waist. She sticks out a finger with her other hand as she delivers a lecture.
units.displayText: Alcyone plants a hand on her waist. She sticks out a finger with her other hand as she delivers a lecture.

spans.text: Alcyone plants a hand on her waist. She sticks out a finger with her other hand as she delivers a lecture.

units.rawText: No. 1: From an operational point of view, destroying such a large energy tower will provide better cover for the other teams. Once such an important facility is destroyed, the Daemons will focus their attention on their major energy towers and further ease the pressure on the other.
units.displayText: No. 1: From an operational point of view, destroying such a large energy tower will provide better cover for the other teams. Once such an important facility is destroyed, the Daemons will focus their attention on their major energy towers and further ease the pressure on the other.

spans.text: No. 1: From an operational point of view, destroying such a large energy tower will provide better cover for the other teams. Once such an important facility is destroyed, the Daemons will focus their attention on their major energy towers and further ease the pressure on the other.

units.rawText: No. 2: Strategically speaking, destroying the large energy towers will weaken the defense posture of Tartarus. Our ultimate objective is to complete this decapitation operation and cleanse the Tartarus Sector. Therefore, destroying this energy tower is extremely valuable.
units.displayText: No. 2: Strategically speaking, destroying the large energy towers will weaken the defense posture of Tartarus. Our ultimate objective is to complete this decapitation operation and cleanse the Tartarus Sector. Therefore, destroying this energy tower is extremely valuable.

spans.text: No. 2: Strategically speaking, destroying the large energy towers will weaken the defense posture of Tartarus. Our ultimate objective is to complete this decapitation operation and cleanse the Tartarus Sector. Therefore, destroying this energy tower is extremely valuable.

units.rawText: No. 3: If you're truly worried about the risk, then all we need to do is infiltrate the Entropic horde with our Spoof Codes and destroy the energy tower before retreating immediately. That way, we avoid combat and minimize the risk to us.
units.displayText: No. 3: If you're truly worried about the risk, then all we need to do is infiltrate the Entropic horde with our Spoof Codes and destroy the energy tower before retreating immediately. That way, we avoid combat and minimize the risk to us.

spans.text: No. 3: If you're truly worried about the risk, then all we need to do is infiltrate the Entropic horde with our Spoof Codes and destroy the energy tower before retreating immediately. That way, we avoid combat and minimize the risk to us.

units.rawText: After seeing the three fingers Alcyone is confidently holding up, Electra's expression softens a little.
units.displayText: After seeing the three fingers Alcyone is confidently holding up, Electra's expression softens a little.

spans.text: After seeing the three fingers Alcyone is confidently holding up, Electra's expression softens a little.

units.rawText: Well, I have to hand it to you, Ally. You certainly thought of everything. In that case, let's sneak in.
units.displayText: Well, I have to hand it to you, Ally. You certainly thought of everything. In that case, let's sneak in.

spans.text: Well, I have to hand it to you, Ally. You certainly thought of everything. In that case, let's sneak in.

units.rawText: Even if an accident DOES occur, I can still protect you. After all, I have quite a bit of experience with stealth missions.
units.displayText: Even if an accident DOES occur, I can still protect you. After all, I have quite a bit of experience with stealth missions.

spans.text: Even if an accident DOES occur, I can still protect you. After all, I have quite a bit of experience with stealth missions.

units.rawText: Humph, you'd better mind yourself. I scored higher than you on the infiltration exercises!
units.displayText: Humph, you'd better mind yourself. I scored higher than you on the infiltration exercises!

spans.text: Humph, you'd better mind yourself. I scored higher than you on the infiltration exercises!

units.rawText: Um... It's not an infiltration if you kill everyone you encounter.
units.displayText: Um... It's not an infiltration if you kill everyone you encounter.

spans.text: Um... It's not an infiltration if you kill everyone you encounter.

units.rawText: Objectively speaking, the infiltration is successful if nobody sees me (and lives)!
units.displayText: Objectively speaking, the infiltration is successful if nobody sees me (and lives)!

spans.text: Objectively speaking, the infiltration is successful if nobody sees me (and lives)!

units.rawText: Okay, okay, you're the boss~
units.displayText: Okay, okay, you're the boss~

spans.text: Okay, okay, you're the boss~

units.rawText: Hey! Quit patting my head!
units.displayText: Hey! Quit patting my head!

spans.text: Hey! Quit patting my head!

units.rawText: Alcyone annoyedly frees her hair from Electra's oppression and mutters to herself as she smooths it out.
units.displayText: Alcyone annoyedly frees her hair from Electra's oppression and mutters to herself as she smooths it out.

spans.text: Alcyone annoyedly frees her hair from Electra's oppression and mutters to herself as she smooths it out.

units.rawText: <size=28>I'm not that kid you have to keep worrying about anymore...</size>
units.displayText: I'm not that kid you have to keep worrying about anymore...

spans.text: I'm not that kid you have to keep worrying about anymore...
